notes.title: Updated our previous game, the hiphop western Luckslinger!
notes.notes:
In Luckslinger, luck is measurable, collectable and usable whenever you please. Contains: gunslingers, dark humor, spaghetti western, vinyl digging, graffiti spraying and jazzy hip hop beats.

Game page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/358810/Luckslinger/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/358810/Luckslinger/[/url]

The main changes for the game are:
[list]
[*] More checkpoints in each level! Keeping the clutch gameplay intact but a bit more forgiving overall
[*] Luckslinger now has stronger leg muscles and can jump higher
[*] Playstation controller support!
[*] In the saloon you can acquire another extra HP, allowing the opportunity for 5 HP max
[*] More health, luck and money drops
[*] Other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Come playtest the game! (CLOSED)
notes.notes:
This is for those that want to play the game and help it make better. We activated the new playtest feature in steam to get some more feedback on the entire game (not just the demo). 

So if you want to give it a try, and maybe let us in on some of your thoughts. Please sign up!

Signing up can be done by clicking the "Request access" button on the games page.

Cheers!
-Donald

EDIT: we decided to close the submissions for now in this round 1 of playtesting

notes.title: Try the demo and let us know what's up!
notes.notes:
We are team Duckbridge and we wanted to create a rhythm game that is less about performing perfect combo chains, and more about head bopping to the beats and vibing along.

We are a team of 3 and we try to give the music in our games a front row spot. On par with the mechanics, dialogue and story. 

This is our second full feature game, the previous one being the hiphop western game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/358810/Luckslinger/]Luckslinger[/url]. In which you have to collect and use luck.

notes.title: Come try the free demo!
notes.notes:
We just uploaded the steam demo for windows, mac and linux.

Give the demo a try and let us know what you think and find :) Its the start of the game all the way to the first boss. With some nice tweaks here and there.

You can find the demo on the full game page but also as a separate game in the steam launcher. 

Cheers!
Donald
